description: This Java class 'ReadableOrder' extends 'OrderEntity' and represents a readable view of an order in the e-commerce system. It contains fields for customer details, products, currency, billing and delivery addresses, and order totals like total, tax, and shipping. The class includes getters and setters for these fields.

classes.name: ReadableOrder
classes.description: A serializable representation of an order with customer, product, address, and total details.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Retrieves the tax amount for the order.

methods.name: setTax
methods.description: Sets the tax amount for the order.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping total for the order.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping total for the order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of products in the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyModel
methods.description: Returns the currency model used in the order.

methods.name: setCurrencyModel
methods.description: Sets the currency model for the order.
